## Library loading

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
library("table1")
library("ggridges")
```

## Load data

To describe the data for analysis, both joined data frames are loaded for further exploration.

```{r}
inner_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_inner.tsv"))
left_df <- read_tsv(file = here("data/03_dat_aug_left.tsv"))
```

## Data coverage

Data coverage was inspected through a simple count of the available data points throughout all 3 datasets. A Venn diagram was also made to better visualize how data is distributed.

```{r}
# Simple description of the data found
left_df |>
  summarise(countries = n_distinct(country_code),
            first_year = min(year),
            last_year = max(year))

# Number of values per variable
left_df |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mortality_rate,
                        measles_coverage,
                        stunting_prevalence),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value") |>
  drop_na(value) |>
  count(variable)

# Which country-year appears in which dataset
coverage_data <- bind_rows(
  mortality_clean |> select(country_code, year) |> mutate(dataset = "Mortality"),
  measles_clean |> select(country_code, year) |> mutate(dataset = "Measles"),
  stunting_clean |> select(country_code, year) |> mutate(dataset = "Stunting")
) |>
  distinct()

# Number of data points in each combination of datasets
combo_counts <- coverage_data |>
  group_by(country_code, year) |>
  summarise(combination = str_c(dataset, collapse = " + ")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(combination)

# Bar plot of shared data points
combo_counts |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n,
             y = fct_reorder(combination, n))) +
  geom_col(fill = "#338530") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n),
            hjust = -0.2) +
  labs(title = "Available data points in each combination of datasets",
       x = "Number of country-year data points",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# Line plot of countries with data per year
coverage_data |>
  count(year, dataset) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year,
             y = n,
             colour = dataset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d() +
  labs(title = "Countries with data per year",
       x = "Year",
       y = "Number of countries",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```


## Medians by region in latest decade

To describe the current situation across regions, each country's data was summarised over the last 2 decades (2000–2020). For every country, the median under-5 mortality rate, measles vaccine coverage, and stunting prevalence across the available years were calculated, giving one value per country.

By using the median, the influence of single unusual years is reduced and sparse data, like stunting prevalence, is used to describe the decade. The country values were also summarised by region, including the number of countries with missing data for each variable.

```{r}
#| message: false

# Info presented in a tidy table
left_df |>
  filter(between(year, 2000, 2020)) |>
  group_by(country_code, region) |>
  summarise(Mortality_rate = median(mortality_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
            Measles_coverage = median(measles_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
            Stunting_prevalence = median(stunting_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
            ungroup() |>
  mutate(who_region = factor(region)) |>
  table1(x = formula(~ Mortality_rate + Measles_coverage + Stunting_prevalence | who_region),
         data = _)
```

## Visualize data by decades with ridgeline plot

To visualize how under-5 mortality has changed over time, a ridgeline plot was created spanning from 1960 to 2020. Due to missing information in the intersections of the 3 datasets, only information from 2000 onwards is shown. Each ridge shows how countries in different regions were spread across mortality levels in that year, and the vertical line marks the median.

```{r}
# Prepare data for plot
ridge_data <- left_df |>
  mutate(decade = floor(year / 10) * 10) |>
  filter(year == decade,
         decade >= 1960) |>
  drop_na(mortality_rate) |>
  mutate(decade = as_factor(decade))

# Ridgeline plot for under-5 mortality per region
ridge_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = mortality_rate,
             y = fct_rev(decade),
             fill = decade)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.5,
                      alpha = 0.8,
                      quantile_lines = TRUE,
                      quantiles = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ region) +
  labs(title = "Under-5 mortality by decade and WHO region",
       x = "Under-5 mortality (per 1,000 live births, log scale)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_ridges() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9))

```
